text: Login fails between @web/src/login.ts and @api/src/auth.ts, see docs/architecture.md

The web app called the wrong route. Fixed in `web/src/login.ts:2`; the server side is `api/src/auth.ts:3-5`.

- By a name only one repo has: `auth.ts`, `login.ts:2`.
- From the workspace itself: `docker-compose.yml` and docs/architecture.md.
- A folder: `api/src/`.
- A name both repos have isn't linked: `index.ts`, but with its repo it is: `api/src/index.ts` and `web/src/index.ts`.
- Not linked, ignored in a repo: `api/dist/server.js`. Outside the workspace: /etc/hosts.
